reasons: The v0.4 benchmark is retained for mechanism and audit diagnostics, but its latent mechanism templates were reused across diagnostic and formal boundaries and are not an independent final benchmark.

The artifact predates the P2.1 evaluator boundary: pre-action raw observations, Pairwise Reversal Ranking Accuracy, selected-action confirmation receipts, question-macro weighting, and seed-by-question/family-LOO uncertainty.
The historical primary files and run-manifest digests are retained unchanged; this additive notice changes interpretation, not the historical bytes.
allowed_uses: debugging the v0.4 data-generation and trajectory protocol
comparison against the fresh P2.1 diagnostic only when explicitly labelled historical
disallowed_uses: post-fix algorithm selection or hyperparameter tuning
formal superiority, generalization, or clean-final claims
